subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word segment that rectifies the bracketed word segment and complete the given sentence meaningfully.

It took quite (few some time) to finish the project.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**few some time**" is grammatically incorrect and does not convey the intended meaning.
 
• The correct term "**some time**" is used to refer to an unspecified amount of time required to complete a task.
 
• Replacing "**few some time**" with "**some time**" makes the sentence grammatically correct and meaningful.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"It took quite some time to finish the project."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "a time some"** – This arrangement is grammatically incorrect and does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: "some a time"** – This phrase is also grammatically incorrect and nonsensical.
 
• **Option 4: "time"** – While grammatically correct, it does not fully capture the intended meaning of the sentence.
